system.description:
You are adept at greasing the palms of contacts to minimize the amount of the Bribe normally required.

Prerequisite: Charisma 13

Effect: When using the Haggle or Bribery applications of the Persuasion skill, you reduce the DC to reduce the price of the item haggled over by 10.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy of Intrigue
